highestLift.title: Highest Lift Rule
highestLift.rule: GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER -> PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER
highestLift.explanation: Shoppers who buy 'GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER' are 18.89 times more likely to purchase 'PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER' than a random customer.
highestLift.whyItMatters: Indicates extreme behavioral co-dependence. Customers view these products as parts of an inseparable collection.
highestLift.recommendation: Package these items as a unified gift set or premium bundle with zero cross-sell friction at checkout.

highestConfidence.title: Highest Confidence Rule
highestConfidence.rule: PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER -> GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER
highestConfidence.explanation: Over 90.35% of shoppers purchasing 'PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER' also place 'GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER' in the same basket.
highestConfidence.whyItMatters: Extremely high predictive certainty. This is essentially an automatic complementary conversion.
highestConfidence.recommendation: Display '{', '.join(top_conf_rule['consequents'])}' as a 1-click add-on whenever the antecedent items are in the cart.

highestSupport.title: Highest Support Volume
highestSupport.rule: JUMBO BAG PINK POLKADOT -> JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT
highestSupport.explanation: This combination appears in 819 separate transactions (4.15% of all store baskets).
highestSupport.whyItMatters: Represents the highest revenue-volume pair in the entire catalog. Small improvements here yield massive bottom-line impact.
highestSupport.recommendation: Feature this pairing on the home page hero and prime retail aisle displays.

mostFrequentProduct.title: Most Frequent Anchor Product
mostFrequentProduct.explanation: Found in 2,202 transactions, 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' is the single most common item in the entire store.
mostFrequentProduct.whyItMatters: This is the primary customer acquisition and basket-starter anchor for the business.
mostFrequentProduct.recommendation: Maintain guaranteed in-stock availability and use as a gateway item to cross-sell lower-velocity accessories.

mostConnectedProduct.title: Most Connected Product Node
mostConnectedProduct.explanation: 'JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT' appears in 16 distinct association rules across antecedents and consequents.
mostConnectedProduct.whyItMatters: Acts as the central hub of customer purchase journeys. Changes to this product's price or stock affect numerous other SKUs.
mostConnectedProduct.recommendation: Treat as a strategic keystone SKU in promotional campaigns.
